declared: 2026-11-12, before the frozen rustc 1.98.0 oracle of these exact bytes and before any RustGM run of each batch (obj/parallel/branch-unsize/core/declared.json, batches 1-3). Each case's first line records its prefix.
declaration_agreement: 13/14 declared outcomes agree with rustc; adjusted-earlier.rs was declared reject (E0308) and rustc accepts it. Its rustc outcome is the oracle.

core-as-slice.rs.form: core form: if s.finished { &[] } else { &s.v } returns &'a [T]; &[] unsizes and &s.v derefs to the expected type

core-next-back.rs.form: core form: let remainder = if e { &[] } else { tail(v) } with tail returning &'a [T]

ret-expected.rs.form: if c { &[] } else { v } with an expected &'a [T]

let-annotated.rs.form: let r: &[u8] = if c { &[1] } else { &[1, 2] }; both arrays unsize to the annotation

lub-later.rs.form: let r = if c { &[] } else { v }; no expected type, so the earlier &[_; 0] branch unsizes to the later &[T]

lub-earlier.rs.form: let r = if c { v } else { &[] }; the later &[_; 0] coerces to the merged &[T]

else-if.rs.form: let r = if a { &[] } else if b { v } else { &[] }

lub-arrays.rs.form: E0308 expected: let r = if c { &[1u8] } else { &[1u8, 2] }; two array lengths have no least upper bound

mut-slice-later.rs.form: E0308 expected: let r = if c { &[] } else { v } with v: &mut [T]; neither direction coerces

lub-deref.rs.form: E0308 expected: let r = if c { &[] } else { &v } with v: &[T]; without an expectation &&[T] does not deref to the earlier type

adjusted-earlier.rs.form: E0308 expected: match k { 0 => &mut [1u8, 2], 1 => &[3u8, 4], _ => v }; arm 0 already took a &mut-to-& adjustment, so rustc will not coerce the earlier arms to the later &[u8]

noop-earlier.rs.form: control: match k { 0 => &[1u8, 2], 1 => &[3u8, 4], _ => v }; the earlier arms took no adjustment
